releaseNotes: feat: Add About, Appearance, and Updates screens with localization support
changelog: Implemented AboutScreen with developer information and Discord community link.
Created AppearanceScreen for theme and language selection, including haptic feedback settings.
Developed UpdatesScreen for managing update preferences and permissions.
Added new strings for localization in Arabic and English.
Introduced a Discord icon for community access.
Added unit tests for panel sync retry logic.
